mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_live_post (board_group_idx, user_id, content) VALUES (#{boardGroupIdx}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT p.live_post_idx, p.board_group_idx, p.user_id, p.content, p.created_at, m.USER_NAME AS writer FROM tb_live_post p JOIN members m ON p.user_id = m.USER_ID WHERE p.live_post_idx = #{livePostIdx}
